file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for University of Sunderland MBChB Medicine A100 2027 entry. Executable rules live in data/universities/sunderland-a100.json; this file preserves source interpretation, implementation boundaries and evidence gaps.

research_scope.notes: The supplied research Markdown is treated as authoritative. Sunderland's official adjusted 2020-2024 UCAT values are retained without reconversion and displayed only as historical context.

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or statistic attributed by the supplied research to a first-party Sunderland, UCAS, MSC or UCAT Consortium source.
evidence_classification_policy.foi_verified: Statistics confirmed by a Freedom of Information response cited in the supplied research.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: Cycle-labelled Sunderland UCAT values used only for context, never as current guaranteed thresholds.
evidence_classification_policy.engine_boundary: Evidence exists, but ApplySmart cannot execute it without unpublished applicant-level data or an approved extension.

minimum_architecture_extension_required: Generic opt-in graduate compensatory admissions-test policy where a test may compensate exactly one configured academic deficiency while UCAT/SJT remain mandatory.
resolved_architecture_extensions: Data-driven graduate compensatory admissions-test policy implemented in assets/js/engine/graduate-compensatory-policy.js and wired into the eligibility evaluator and interview-band classifier.

engine_execution_boundaries: Sunderland's Interview Selection Tool is assessed and used for shortlisting, but the numeric formula and cut-score are unpublished.
ApplySmart does not collect the full IST written-response dataset and does not create an IST score.
The generic Scottish classifier executes National 5 and Advanced Higher science requirements; the production JSON retains the full Higher AAAAB policy.
IB SL 6,6,5 and HL English-for-GCSE-English substitution are retained as metadata while the generic classifier executes total and HL science requirements.
readiness.summary: Sunderland A100 is production-ready for eligibility checking and evidence-limited interview guidance. Eligible applicants are not marked manual review solely because the IST formula is unpublished; guidance is withheld as an evidence-safe methodology limitation.

course_identity.medical_school: School of Medicine, University of Sunderland

steps: UCAT top-eight-national-deciles gate and SJT Band 1-3 gate.
Admissions Tutors assess the Interview Selection Tool.
Final post-interview decisions are outside ApplySmart scope.

standard_route_requires: Degree within the documented permitted period.
BBB A-level route in required subjects.
compensable_deficiencies: A-level subject or grade requirement only.
not_compensable: Both A-level and GCSE science deficiencies together.
thresholds: 55 overall with Section III at least 58 and no section below 50.
58 overall with Section III at least 55 and no section below 50.

historical_ucat_guidance.notes: These figures are Sunderland-published adjusted values on the post-2025 2700 scale and must not be reconverted.

criteria: Evidence of extensive engagement in activities involving care, support and/or service.
Nature of experience and level of responsibility.
Open-ended written responses within an SJT-style assessment.
experience_rules: Experience must be from the previous two years unless ongoing experience began earlier.
Hands-on public-facing paid or voluntary work or significant family caregiving can count.
School-organised programmes and clinical shadowing do not qualify.
Up to four experiences can be listed; total commitment matters more than number of experiences.

evidence_gaps.notes: Sunderland confirms assessed IST shortlisting but does not publish the numeric scoring formula or cut-score.
A 2023/24 policy version reportedly referred to Big Five traits; this is not present in the current 2026/27 official text and is not implemented.
Recent applications/interviews/offers for 2023-2025 were not found.
MMI station count and duration are not needed for interview invitation guidance.
